ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels comprise approximately 90-95 percent of the visible ventral fluke surface, resulting in a low macro-level contrast ratio relative to the surrounding water.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly distributed low-intensity dark gray to black pixels across the main lobe bodies; small, contiguous clusters of high-intensity white pixels are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an internal convergence angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the posterior boundary; irregular peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes and non-uniform periodicity across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels at the extreme distal tips, exhibiting roughly circular and overlapping geometric patterns consistent with calcified scarring or colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular morphology and high-intensity white scarring on the distal tips, suggesting previous tissue loss or significant abrasion.
